descriptionHtml:
Decision D2 · P0 · Preston

Is adding a unit to a bare value (temperature 38 → 38 °C, 60 → 60 °F) an 'invented unit'? (GK11)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-15/S16, TC-23/S15

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S16 A stored bare temperature is labelled °C by range on the panel and in the note context (conflicting evidence for 3.4)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value. (UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Tim's chromium test: Hospital patient with vitals temp '37.4' and weight '72' stored bare

When Open the chart, then Generate Note with mocked model calls

Then The existing test expects the Vitals panel to show 37.4 with no °F and the note's patient context VITALS line to read 'Temp 37.4°C'; the weight gets no unit

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on the panel text and the generateNote request args. No °F supports U3. But the test asserts that a °C label is added to a bare 37.4, which under 3.4 ('no guessed units on ambiguous values') and Vikram's note prompts (a bare temperature stays bare: note/patient-context.md, note/clinical-quality.md) is an added unit. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Preston.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S16

A stored bare temperature is labelled °C by range on the panel and in the note context (conflicting evidence for 3.4)

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

Tim's test asserts that a bare 37.4 is sent to generation as 'Temp 37.4°C'; the matrix says a pass here is a finding against U7, not support for U3. Waits on D2 (Preston). The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

Result: passed in matrix/TC-23.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • medication-tracker.spec.ts [chromium] — a bare Celsius temperature is never sent as Fahrenheit, and a bare weight gets no unit (UAT TC-19) — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium spec in e2e/medication-tracker.spec.ts): it stores the bare vitals with createRoundingPatient through e2e/support (local admin key) on a fresh @roundai.test account, presses Generate Note with the model calls mocked (action-observer) and asserts the generateNote request arg…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
